findings.title: Install skips unregistering non-enabled owned jobs
findings.problem: snapshotPreviousInstall keeps in previous.jobs only owned names whose query() returned enabled (query errors map to disabled), and replaceJob unregisters only previous.jobs. The previous code unregistered the default name unconditionally, and unregister() is documented to remove enabled or disabled jobs. A disabled or unqueryable old-suffix or default-name job is left on disk. PreviousInstall.names ('the only names install may unregister') is populated but never used.
findings.impact: Reinstall under a new name can leave a stale job registered, breaking the 'exactly one job' guarantee (AC4/AC5, spec step 7). A transient query failure silently skips removal. Reachability confirmed by reading the code.
findings.recommendation: In replaceJob, unregister every name in previous.names (tolerant of absent jobs). Keep restorePreviousInstall limited to previous.jobs (previously enabled).
